title: MSC Just Ended Maersk's 25-Year Reign
source: Alphaliner container-fleet rankings as reported by maritime trade press (Riviera Maritime Media, Marine Insight, Splash247/Lloyd's List coverage of Alphaliner data). MSC overtook Maersk in January 2022 to become the world's largest container shipping line by deployed capacity, ending Maersk's roughly 25-year run at #1; figures are approximate fleet-capacity snapshots.
